lemmas.primary_translation: to say or do something seemingly insignificant that has unexpected negative consequences

definitions.text: si eller gjøre noe tilsynelatende ubetydelig som får uventede negative konsekvenser
definitions.translation: to say or do something seemingly insignificant that has unexpected negative consequences (lit. sow wind and reap storm)

examples.no: utvalget har sådd vind og høstet storm med forslaget sitt
examples.en: the committee has sown the wind and reaped the whirlwind with its proposal
